review_checks.62511d43-8eaf-405a-9c81-7bd593d3a01e: Other creatures, including opponents', become Food artifacts; Ygra excludes itself. Ward cost belongs to targeting opponent. Food-to-graveyard triggers are not limited to own sacrifices. Respect no-infinite-combo goal; another candidate is not current support.
review_checks.63788566-e25a-44bb-bb55-197e1b93b3e8: Every mode costs one mana and tap, plus its stated resource. Artifact sacrifice can consume noncreature Food and draw; creature sacrifice returns an artifact to hand, not battlefield. One sacrifice cannot pay two modes.
review_checks.916bd025-c44f-49c9-8d76-4b7b2f9a8ba3: Global -1/-1 hits own creatures too; ordinary 1/1 Squirrels die absent a buff. Do not describe it as opponents-only or an anthem for the deck.
review_checks.0636b6c3-0662-420a-b30d-f0a14e7c512d: Body is 2/3. Creating or sacrificing each token drains each opponent; do not invent a nontoken or once-per-turn restriction.
review_checks.4d18bcba-a346-445e-a182-6cc30b7e066d: Sacrifices creatures, including Food creatures such as Tough Cookie and Gingerbrute, which can trigger Camellia. Does not sacrifice noncreature Foods. Other outlets do not share one payment.
review_checks.4421ab7d-6d9b-4edd-b5a0-53a8ed84da6f: Ward sacrifice is paid by the targeting opponent, not the permanent's controller. Nonpayment counters the opposing spell/ability. Review hand ability as printed rather than inventing costs.
review_checks.5ea93956-085d-409b-bd95-dd669fa69eeb: Its upkeep Gingerbrute tokens are Food artifact creatures. Monarch dependence and six mana are real costs, but denying Food support is not.

review_checks.3640c29b-1534-4952-b297-619ade948431: Choose Wizard or Merfolk to double Talrand's triggered ability. Does not double all spells, static abilities, or its own triggers. Its ward cost is paid by targeting opponent.
review_checks.8c0520fa-276b-4d21-b4a9-dce1fce59f6b: Noncreature-spell casts make Sharks by mana value. Cycling draws and creates a Shark but is not casting an instant/sorcery and does not itself trigger Talrand.
review_checks.6b071146-2f83-4fda-a55a-46fcb74e6f28: Casting or copying an instant/sorcery triggers Deekah; ordinary copies are not cast and do not trigger Talrand. Token starts 0/0 with counters equal to mana value, not power.
review_checks.22d7048e-d538-4fd3-9fb3-2e99e74875fe: Reduces generic cost of instants/sorceries and scries on their casts. Does not draw cards, discount colored symbols or require a Jace planeswalker.
review_checks.43355ac4-bf8c-48f6-a322-fafbc9d132d1: Sorcery creates two 2/2 flying Drakes; casting it with Talrand present adds one more from the cast trigger. Token creation itself does not retrigger Talrand.
review_checks.67c603cc-ad66-4a1c-8386-5901c9c01bfb: Printed prepared reminder allows casting a copy and unprepares the creature. Do not deny that explicit access; do not invent free casting or fully specified novel-keyword timing.
review_checks.ecdfee75-15fd-41ea-89d4-4bfc1fa4d032: Empower reminder creates a Jace token if absent and puts loyalty counters on it. Existing Jace support is not necessary for the printed self-contained effect.
review_checks.7d5149c6-0e7e-438c-a554-5235c85e2426: Instant/sorcery casts create Constructs by mana value. Five-mana opportunity cost is defensible; its graveyard-return activation needs six artifacts and exiles the enchantment.
